role_context: Genome-scale CD4+ T-cell CRISPRi (Gladstone/Marson) causal->PPI network nomination. VAV2 enrichment 3.5; causal-hit neighbours SYK, PLCG1, ZAP70, ITK, VAV1 - it sits in the exact TCR-proximal module as a VAV1 paralog. The most biologically coherent NOVEL immune nomination on network grounds.
biology: Guanine-nucleotide exchange factor (GEF) for Rho-family GTPases (Rac1/RhoA/Cdc42), a paralog of the hematopoietic VAV1. Downstream of antigen receptors the VAV proteins couple SYK/ZAP70 to actin remodelling, NFAT and SRF-dependent transcription. VAV2 also enhances SRF via Rho GTPases in lymphocytes (Charvet et al., J Biol Chem 2002, PMID 11859076) and cooperates with 3BP2 to activate NFAT (Foucault et al., Blood 2004, PMID 15345594). VAV2/VAV3 are more broadly expressed than VAV1, so there is partial paralog redundancy in T cells.

tractability.interpretation: OT shows NO small-molecule tractability of any kind (no structural ligand, no druggable family) and no antibody target-quality - consistent with the known difficulty of drugging guanine-nucleotide exchange factors. Highest novelty, highest risk.

genetic_evidence.IMPORTANT_caveat: VAV2's human genetics are NOT autoimmune - the top OT associations are glaucoma / hypertension / vascular (VAV2 has a known role in vascular/renal biology), with type-1-diabetes only weak (0.26). So VAV2's nomination rests on NETWORK/paralog coherence (VAV1 paralog inside the TCR module), NOT on human-genetic support for an immune indication. State this honestly.
genetic_evidence.direction: no signed disease-direction; nomination is mechanistic/network, not genetic.

honest_caveats: Genetics are non-immune (glaucoma/hypertension) - the immune rationale is paralog/network, not genetic.
Partial functional redundancy with VAV1 (and VAV3) in T cells could blunt a single-gene therapeutic effect.
Undrugged GEF target class - no chemical starting point; a genuine high-risk/high-reward discovery, not a near-term program.
